hypotheses.D1_tangent_is_exact_at_point_one_percent: Top-axis tangent effects have median Fisher fidelity at least 0.99 at 0.1% input-norm edits on both corpora.
hypotheses.D2_tangent_remains_faithful_at_one_perce: Top-axis tangent effects have median Fisher fidelity at least 0.95 at 1% input-norm edits on both corpora.
hypotheses.D3_tangent_is_useful_at_five_percent: Top-axis tangent effects have median Fisher fidelity at least 0.80 at 5% input-norm edits on both corpora.
hypotheses.D4_axis_token_signs_validate: At 1%, at least 90% of the ten most affected token probability signs agree with the tangent prediction on both corpora.
hypotheses.D5_top_axes_beat_random_directions: At 1%, the median top-axis KL is at least twice the median random-direction KL on both corpora.
